name: Crowdfunding Service Provider (AMLR obliged)
description: Crowdfunding Service Provider under EU Regulation 2020/1503 + AMLR. Equity, lending or reward-based platforms. Focus: project-owner DD, investor SoF, payment flows on and off platform, suitability + appropriateness, market-abuse on secondary markets.

recommends_fcp_domains.rationale: Investor onboarding fraud, project-owner misrepresentation, mule investors.
If a secondary market is offered, MAR-style obligations apply.
